rem 250250
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=250
rem Count the non-empty subsets of the
rem numbers k^k, k up to N, whose sum is
rem divisible by M; give the last 16
rem digits

use numbers
use io
use cli

arg N integer = 250250
arg M integer = 250
arg Mod integer = 10000000000000000

rem Count the subsets by sum mod M. A
rem number with residue r adds each old
rem count to the one r places up.
Cnt = array shape M fill 0
Cnt 0 = 1
Old = Cnt
for K in 1 to N
  R = K K M powmod
  for S in 0 till M
    Old S = Cnt S
  end
  for S in 0 till M
    From = (S + M - R) mod M
    Cnt S = (Old S + Old From) mod Mod
  end
end
Answer = (Cnt 0 - 1) mod Mod
Answer print

rem 250250
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=250
rem Count the non-empty subsets of the
rem numbers k^k, k up to N, whose sum is
rem divisible by M; give the last 16
rem digits

use numbers
use io
use cli

arg N integer = 250250
arg M integer = 250
arg Mod integer = 10000000000000000

fun N counts M Low High
  Cnt = array shape M fill 0
  Cnt 0 = 1
  if High equal 1
    Cnt 0 = 0 - Low
  end
  Old = array shape M fill 0
  for K in 1 to N
    R = K K M powmod
    for S in 0 till M
      Old S = Cnt S
    end
    for S in 0 till M
      From = (S + M - R) mod M
      Value = Old S
      Add = Old From
      if Add at least 0
        if Value at least High - Add
          Value -= High
          Add -= Low
        end
      else
        if Value less (0 - Low) - Add
          Value += Low
          Add += High
        end
      end
      Cnt S = Value + Add
    end
  end
  return Cnt
end

Low = Mod // 2
High = Mod - Low
Cnt = N counts M Low High
Answer = (Cnt 0 - 1) mod Mod
Answer print

rem 250250
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=250
rem Count the non-empty subsets of the
rem numbers k^k, k up to N, whose sum is
rem divisible by M; give the last 16
rem digits

use numbers
use bits
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg N integer = 250250
arg M integer = 250
arg Mod integer = 10000000000000000

fun A times B M Mod
  C = array shape M fill 0
  for I in 0 till M
    Ai = A I
    if Ai not equal 0
      for J in 0 till M
        Ix = (I + J) mod M
        C Ix = (C Ix + Ai * B J) mod Mod
      end
    end
  end
  return C
end

fun Start block Count M Mod
  Cnt = array shape M fill 0
  Old = array shape M fill 0
  Cnt 0 = 1
  for K in Start till (Start + Count)
    R = K K M powmod
    for S in 0 till M
      Old S = Cnt S
    end
    for S in 0 till M
      From = (S + M - R) mod M
      Cnt S = (Old S + Old From) mod Mod
    end
  end
  return Cnt
end

Phi = M
for P in (M factors array unique)
  Phi = Phi // P * (P - 1)
end
Period = M lcm Phi
Prefix = N
if N greater M + Period
  Prefix = M + (N - M) mod Period
end
Res = 1 block Prefix M Mod
Q = (N - Prefix) // Period
if Q greater 0
  Base = (Prefix + 1) block Period M Mod
for Step in 1 to (Q binary len)
  if Q mod 2 equal 1
    Res = Res times Base M Mod
  end
  Q = Q // 2
  if Q greater 0
    Base = Base times Base M Mod
  end
end
end
Answer = (Res 0 - 1) mod Mod
Answer print

rem 250250
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=250
rem Count the non-empty subsets of the
rem numbers k^k, k up to N, whose sum is
rem divisible by M; give the last 16
rem digits

use numbers
use bits
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg N integer = 250250
arg M integer = 250
arg Mod integer = 10000000000000000

rem Cyclic product modulo x^M - 1.
rem Reduce after each exact dot product.
fun A cyclic_product B M Mod
  C = array shape M fill 0
  for S in 0 till M
    Total = 0
    for I in 0 till M
      Total += A I * B ((S + M - I) mod M)
    end
    C S = Total mod Mod
  end
  return C
end

fun Start subset_counts Count M Mod
  Cnt = array shape M fill 0
  Old = array shape M fill 0
  Cnt 0 = 1
  for K in Start till (Start + Count)
    R = K K M powmod
    for S in 0 till M
      Old S = Cnt S
    end
    for S in 0 till M
      From = (S + M - R) mod M
      Cnt S = (Old S + Old From) mod Mod
    end
  end
  return Cnt
end

rem After k >= M, k^k mod M repeats
rem every lcm(M, phi(M)) steps. Preserve
rem the prefix, then raise one complete
rem period by cyclic multiplication.
Phi = M
for P in (M factors array unique)
  Phi = Phi // P * (P - 1)
end
Period = M lcm Phi
Prefix = N
if N greater M + Period
  Prefix = M + (N - M) mod Period
end
Res = 1 subset_counts Prefix M Mod
Q = (N - Prefix) // Period
if Q greater 0
  Base = (Prefix + 1) subset_counts Period M Mod
  for Step in 1 to (Q binary len)
    if Q mod 2 equal 1
      Res = Res cyclic_product Base M Mod
    end
    Q = Q // 2
    if Q greater 0
      Base = Base cyclic_product Base M Mod
    end
  end
end
Answer = (Res 0 - 1) mod Mod
Answer print
